# Smarter Tracks

> Smarter Tracks is tool tracking software for construction, HVAC and trades teams. Crews check tools in and out from their phones, every hand-off is logged with a timestamp and the person responsible, and managers run audits from any phone. Everyday tracking needs no tags or hardware. Optional cellular GPS trackers are available for a few high-value items. Pricing is flat, with no per-user fees.

Key facts:
- What it does: tool check-out and check-in, custody tracking (who has each tool), transfer history, phone-based audits, tool photos, damaged-tool reporting.
- Who it's for: construction contractors, HVAC companies, and plumbing, electrical and mechanical field-service teams.
- Hardware: none required. Runs on iOS and Android phones, plus the web.
- Pricing (USD):
  - Starter: $200/month (15 users, 150 tools), or $185/month billed annually ($2,220/year)
  - Pro: $350/month (75 users, 750 tools), or $315/month billed annually ($3,780/year)
  - Custom plans for larger teams
  - No per-user charges, no long-term contracts
  - 90-day money-back guarantee
- Best for: teams that want tool accountability ("who has it, who had it last") without buying and maintaining tags.
- Optional add-on: cellular GPS trackers for a few high-value tools. They use cell service, not Bluetooth, so they do not depend on nearby phones. Longer battery life and a tougher case for job sites. The core product still tracks the rest of the tools with no hardware.
- Over 600 tools tracked on the platform.
- Contact: brockcoburn@smartertracks.com
